answer_1.quote: In this paper, we release a new Machine Translation Gender Evaluation benchmark: MT-GenEval... covers translation from English into eight target languages: Arabic (AR), French (FR), German (DE), Hindi (HI), Italian (IT), Portuguese (PT), Russian (RU), and Spanish (ES).

answer_2.quote: We propose a straightforward accuracy metric... We also define a gender quality gap metric, Δqual, based on BLEU gender... The automatic metric matches humans reasonably well across all language pairs, with F-scores consistently at 0. ...

answer_4.quote: We selected a stratified sample of 600 source segments, translated each with three commercial systems, and asked two professional translators to mark the gender correctness of the system outputs. We also asked two professional translators to judge gender accuracy in context.
answer_4.guideline: Professional translators were asked to mark the gender correctness of each system translation (i.e., whether the translation correctly reflects the gender of the referenced human).
